# systemd compatibility — `org.ono.compat.systemd`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `journalctl`, `systemctl`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## journalctl — `org.ono.compat.systemd.journalctl`

Journal entries as `ono.journal-event/1` records, streamed from `journalctl -o json`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `journalctl` |
| versions | `>=245` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.journal-event/1` |
| decoder | `jsonl` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `systemd/journalctl` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `journalctl [-u\|--unit <unit>] [-p\|--priority <range>] [-n\|--lines <count>] [--since <time>] [--until <time>] [-b\|--boot [id]] [-k\|--dmesg] [-r\|--reverse] [-g\|--grep <pattern>] [-e]` | `journalctl --output=json --no-pager` | `-k`, `--dmesg`, `-r`, `--reverse`, `-e`, `--no-pager`, `-q`, `--quiet`, `--user`, `--system`, `-b`, `--boot`, `-x`, `--catalog`, `-u <value>`, `--unit <value>`, `-p <value>`, `--priority <value>`, `-n <value>`, `--lines <value>`, `--since <value>`, `--until <value>`, `-g <value>`, `--grep <value>`, `-t <value>`, `--identifier <value>`, `--cursor <value>`, `--after-cursor <value>` | — |
| `journalctl -f\|--follow [-u <unit>] [-p <range>] [-n <count>] — a live stream until Ctrl-C` | `journalctl --output=json --no-pager --follow` | `-k`, `--dmesg`, `--user`, `--system`, `-q`, `--quiet`, `-u <value>`, `--unit <value>`, `-p <value>`, `--priority <value>`, `-n <value>`, `--lines <value>`, `--since <value>`, `-g <value>`, `--grep <value>`, `-t <value>`, `--identifier <value>`, `--cursor <value>`, `--after-cursor <value>` | `-f` |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `boot_id` | `_BOOT_ID` |
| `cursor` | `__CURSOR` |
| `host` | `_HOSTNAME` |
| `identifier` | `SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER` |
| `message` | `MESSAGE` |
| `pid` | `_PID` |
| `priority` | `PRIORITY` |
| `timestamp` | `__REALTIME_TIMESTAMP`, unit Microseconds |
| `uid` | `_UID` |
| `unit` | `_SYSTEMD_UNIT` |

### Limits

- `-o/--output` is the adapter's to choose; asking for another output format runs raw.
- `--list-boots`, `--disk-usage`, `--verify` and the maintenance forms are not adapted.
- Every raw journal key (`_COMM`, `_EXE`, `_CMDLINE`, …) is in the extension map, never dropped (spec v0.3 §1.37).

## systemctl-list-units — `org.ono.compat.systemd.systemctl-list-units`

Units as `ono.service/1` records, from `systemctl list-units --output=json`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `systemctl` |
| versions | `>=246` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.service/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `systemd/systemctl-list-units` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `systemctl list-units [-a\|--all] [-t\|--type <type>] [--state <state>] [--failed] [pattern …]` | `systemctl list-units --output=json --no-pager --plain` | `-a`, `--all`, `--failed`, `--user`, `--system`, `--no-pager`, `--plain`, `-l`, `--full`, `-t <value>`, `--type <value>`, `--state <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `description` | `description` |
| `name` | `unit` |
| `state` | `active` |
| `substate` | `sub` |

### Limits

- `pid`, `enabled`, `since` and `unit_file` are not reported by the list; `systemctl show <unit>` answers them.
- `list-unit-files`, `list-timers`, `list-sockets` and every mutation are not adapted (spec v0.3 §1.36).

## systemctl-show — `org.ono.compat.systemd.systemctl-show`

One unit in detail as an `ono.service/1` record, from `systemctl show`'s key=value protocol.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `systemctl` |
| versions | `>=246` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.service/1` |
| decoder | `properties` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `systemd/systemctl-show` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `systemctl show <unit …>` | `systemctl show --no-pager --timestamp=utc -p Id,Description,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,UnitFileState,ActiveEnterTimestamp,FragmentPath` | `--user`, `--system`, `--no-pager` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `description` | `Description` |
| `enabled` | `UnitFileState` |
| `name` | `Id` |
| `pid` | `MainPID` |
| `since` | `ActiveEnterTimestamp` |
| `state` | `ActiveState` |
| `substate` | `SubState` |
| `unit_file` | `FragmentPath` |

### Limits

- `-p/--property` is the adapter's to choose; every other property lands in the extension map only when asked for raw.
- `ActiveEnterTimestamp` is empty for a unit that never started, which is null.
